extracted.intended_audience: school students studying North Carolina / American history (textbook readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A set of chapter-end comprehension and review questions from a North Carolina / American history textbook intended to check students' understanding of events, persons, dates, and consequences described in each chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: Where did Cornwallis next go? What recruits were raised, and who was put in command? Whom had General Greene appointed to watch the enemy?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the surprise and defeat of Colonel Pyle and his men.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: Mention the movements of Major Joseph Graham. Of General Greene.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: Give an account of the affair at Whitsell's Mill.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: What special act of bravery is related?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: What occurred on March 15th, 1781? Give some account of the battle of Guilford Court House?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: How did the engagement terminate ?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: What is said of the British victory? What did General Greene do three days later?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: Where did he then go?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: Where did Cornwallis carry his army?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: Give an account of the battle of Eutaw Springs?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIV Q12
rubrics_metrics.description: Who succeeded Governor Nash, and what is said of him?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: What British forces were in North Carolina after the departure of Cornwallis? Who was in command at Wilmington?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: Can you tell something of Major Craig?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: Tell something of the character of David Fanning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: Give further description of his traits. Mention the horrible condition of the State under Fanning's exploits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: Relate Fanning's attack on the Chatham courtmartial. What occurred at Colonel Alston's house?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: What officer went to attack Fanning? What was the memorable exploit of Fanning On September 12th, 1781?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: What preparations were made for a fight at Lindley's Mill?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: What occurred at Elizabethtown?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: Who became Governor after Governor Burke's capture? How was Governor Burke treated?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: What further account is given of his treatment?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q12
rubrics_metrics.description: Mention the concluding events of his life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q13
rubrics_metrics.description: What was done by General Rutherford upon his exchange?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q14
rubrics_metrics.description: What did he find upon his arrival at Wilmington?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXV Q15
rubrics_metrics.description: State the number of men enlisted in North Carolina during the Revolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: What is said of the surrender of Cornwallis?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: Of what did the English commander complain? What credit is due La Fayette?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: How were the colonies considering the question of peace and independence?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: What was the effect, in England, of the news of Cornwallis's Surrender? When and where was the treaty of peace signed?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: What had North Carolina gained by the war?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: How did our people enjoy peace?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: What is said of the agricultural interest of the State?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: What was the financial condition? The educational?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: What is said of the population?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: What party was victor in the great struggle? What is said of the Tories?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: What was deemed necessary?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVI Q12
rubrics_metrics.description: What plan was adopted towards paying off the soldiers? Mention some payments that were made to commanding officers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: What matters occupied the attention of the people in North Carolina after the Revolution? How were some men disposed to view the new plan of government?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: What was the opinion of Samuel Johnston? What had been provided for in the Halifax Constitution?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: What private schools were in operation, and where were they?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: How was the General Congress greatly embarrassed?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: To what extent did North Carolina sympathize with the general government? What is the present name of that great territory?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: What was done by the Legislature of 1784?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: Why was this a very valuable and timely gift to the government? How did the offer succeed?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: What excitement was created in the west by this donation? Who was the leader of the people? What was Colonel Sevier's opinion of the matter?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: What was done in 1785? What name was given to the new State, and why?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: What proclamation was issued by Governor Caswell? Who was the western leader of Governor Caswell's cause?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: How did the whole matter end? What position did Colonel Sevier afterwards occupy?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVII Q12
rubrics_metrics.description: What other State in the Union originated in this way?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: What question was exciting the people of North Carolina at this period? What was thought of the Confederation?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: How were the people of the State divided upon this great question?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: What other party was formed? What were they called, and what powers did they propose to give to the general government?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: What convention was to meet in 1787?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: Who were chosen to represent North Carolina in that body?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: Who was chosen President of the Convention? How was the new Constitution to be submitted to the people?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: What convention met in Hillsboro in 1788? How did some of the prominent members view the question?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: What different opinion was held by other leading men? What did the Convention do with the Constitution?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: What was the effect on the State? What other States also failed to ratify?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: When did the new government go into operation? Who was chosen first President of the United States? When and where did North Carolina ratify the Constitution and become a member of the united government?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXVIII Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: What two important matters were settled at this period?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q1
rubrics_metrics.description: What was the feeling in North Carolina after the State had joined the Union?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q2
rubrics_metrics.description: How were the effects of American freedom felt in Europe?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q3
rubrics_metrics.description: What great leaders disappeared from North Carolina's councils at this time?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q4
rubrics_metrics.description: What then were fast rising to influence? Who became Governor?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q5
rubrics_metrics.description: When was Raleigh selected as the capital? Why was locating the capital of great good to the State? Go to the map and point out the city of Raleigh.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q6
rubrics_metrics.description: What contest would generally arise at meetings of the Assembly?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q7
rubrics_metrics.description: What mention is made of religious matters?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q8
rubrics_metrics.description: How were the Baptists, Presbyterians and other Christian bodies extending their fields of usefulness?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q9
rubrics_metrics.description: Who became Governor in 1792? What is said of him? What questions did Governor Spaight find agitating the people when he came into office?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q10
rubrics_metrics.description: How was this matter considered by General Washington and others?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q11
rubrics_metrics.description: How were the works of celebrated French writers affecting the people of America?

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapter XXXIX Q12
rubrics_metrics.description: What was to be the conclusion of all these troubles?
